    CPX &C5
    BCC leave_3160

    BCC leave_3160                  \ leave: no update required
.um0db5_is_on_screen
    LDY mover_to_update
    LDA movers_type_and_colour,Y
    AND #&7F
    CMP #&0D                        \ MOVER_TYPE_SKELETON: below it, update
    BCC um0db5_update
    CMP #&13                        \ MOVER_TYPE_MINE: mines are updated too

candidates.summary: update_mover's prologue without get_mover_Y_x_and_y: the right-edge test straight off movers_x_high/low,Y (Y is already mover_to_update), using LDA #&F5 : CMP right_low to get the carry of right_low + &0A into SBC; no LDY; 3 bytes padded back so nothing after moves. Measured -102.8 cycles a pass (seed 1).
candidates.equivalence: Entry: update_movers' loop is the only caller (JSR update_mover, grep-checked, nothing else names it in src/); it does LDY movers_to_update,X : STY mover_to_update just before, so Y = mover_to_update = 1-9 (um_next's range) on entry, and nothing in the new prologue touches Y, so every later use of Y (the type load, plot_mover via animate_explosion_or_skeleton, the LDX/LDY mover_to_update reloads) sees what the removed LDY gave it. The test: the original leaves iff X < C5, or X == C5 and (right_low + &0A) & &FF < mover_x_low, where X = right_high + carry out of right_low + &0A, C5 = movers_x_high,Y and mover_x_low = movers_x_low,Y (what get_mover_Y_x_and_y stored). New: LDA #&F5 : CMP right_low leaves C = 0 exactly when right_low >= &F6 (the carry of right_low + &0A, c); LDA x_high : SBC right_high is then x_high - right_high - c: borrow (BCC) iff x_high < right_high + c = X, the original's BNE-taken on-screen exit; no borrow and nonzero (BNE) iff x_high > X, the original's BCC leave; zero iff x_high == X, where C = 1 so ADC #&09 gives (right_low + &0A) & &FF and CMP movers_x_low,Y/BCC leave is the original's CMP/BCC (carry out of the ADC is not used). right_high is at most &1D (the world is 7,447 columns, docs/level-format.md) so right_high + c never wraps, which is what makes the true-integer and the original's 8-bit X agree (removed movers have x_high = &FF and leave in both). Not stored now on the leave/animate paths: mover_x_low (&F8), &C5 and mover_y (&F9). Every reader sets them first: check_for_player_collision_with_mover_Y starts with JSR get_mover_Y_x_and_y, plot_mover (the skeleton path) writes mover_x_low and &C5 itself and nothing it calls reads mover_y, the next update_mover call does not read them, and update_enemy_helicopter, which runs after the loop every pass, begins check_if_mover_can_be_updated -> check_for_player_collision_with_mover_Y -> get_mover_Y_x_and_y, so all three hold the same values at the end of every pass, before render_pass saves the zero page. Registers/flags: A, X, Y and flags are dead at every exit (the loop reloads X, DEC sets the flags; C is dead per the comment), and um0db5_is_on_screen is entered with Y unchanged and A overwritten by its first load. Measured: passlock 6000 passes seed 1 --screen against the unmodified bench build identical (state and 6000 screens); helilock flight 5 (1651 passes, boarded, shot down) no frame or state differing; pcprof seed 1 logic cycles 10364.9 -> 10262.0 a pass (-102.8), 1500 passes.
candidates.relies_on: update_movers is the only caller and sets Y = mover_to_update; movers_x_high/movers_x_low are within one page for Y 1-9 (the two ASSERTs added; &1366 and &1344 now, so no indexed-read page crossing, 4 cycles each); viewport_right_high <= &1D; mover_x_low (&F8), &C5, mover_y (&F9) rewritten by get_mover_Y_x_and_y at the start of update_enemy_helicopter before any read, every pass. Page crossings: none moved - the 3 bytes the prologue saves are padded back (EQUB x3 after the unconditional JMP, dropped in GAMEPLAY_ANY builds as the neighbouring paddings are), so um0db5_update (&2CDF) and everything after keep their addresses (checked on the bench build's symbols: only um0db5_is_on_screen moved, by 1); the new branches BCC/BNE/BCC all stay within page &2C (update_mover &2CB6-&2CCB, leave_3160 &2CA2) on the bench build.
